description:
Split a segment at the given time offsets (ms, 1-3 cuts → 2-4 parts).
    inherit_index picks which resulting part keeps the original creative data —
    that part keeps its rendered assets, SFX, overlays and continuation links
    (a rendered clip goes stale; re-render it). The other parts start fresh.
    Later segments renumber — re-check get_segments before further edits.

dry_run.description: True previews the consequences without changing anything
dry_run.title: Dry Run

inherit_index.description: 0-based index of the resulting part that keeps the original creative data (default: the first part)
inherit_index.title: Inherit Index

offsets_ms.description: Cut points as millisecond offsets from the segment start, ascending; 1-3 cuts producing 2-4 parts
offsets_ms.title: Offsets Ms

project_id.description: Project ID, as returned by create_project or list_projects
project_id.title: Project Id

segment_number.description: 1-based number of the segment to split, as reported by get_segments
segment_number.title: Segment Number

name: split_segment
title: Split segment
